# `app.graycard.instance.scanSetup`

A reusable modular setup for photographing or otherwise digitizing physical originals. Components and their relationships are open-ended rather than tied to one camera-scanning method.

- **Source:** `lexicons/app/graycard/instance/scanSetup.json`

<a id="component"></a>

## `component`

One role in an assembled digitization setup. ref may identify any owned equipment, including an existing camera, lens, or scanner; label covers unlisted or borrowed equipment. Roles are open-ended.
